Pressure Washing in Mount Prospect, IL

What's Included

Pressure washing (also called power washing) strips years of dirt, algae, mold, mildew and oil stains off hard surfaces. On driveways we pre-treat, surface clean and post-treat with an eco-friendly solution so the concrete stays cleaner for longer. On siding we soft wash at low pressure, which cleans without damaging the surface.

  • Driveways and parking pads
  • Patios, walkways and steps
  • Decks (prepped for sealing or staining)
  • Low-pressure soft wash for house siding
  • Pressure and technique matched to each surface
